rows.name: GPQA Diamond
rows.focus: Highest-quality 198-question subset: both experts answer correctly and the majority of non-experts answer incorrectly.
rows.metrics_detail:
Quality [paper]: Accuracy by subset (%) — Diamond column of Tables 5 and 6: accuracy % for Llama-2-70B-chat, GPT-3.5-turbo-16k, GPT-4 and expert/non-expert human validators · https://arxiv.org/html/2311.12022
Effort [paper]: Evaluation Method (Zero-Shot, Few-Shot, Zero-Shot CoT, Few-Shot CoT, GPT-4 with search) — separate rows per prompting method / with web search · https://arxiv.org/html/2311.12022
Other [paper]: Abstention rate (%) — Table 7 gives the Diamond abstention rate per model/method
rows.notes: Leaderboard is the Hugging Face 'Official Benchmark' leaderboard on the dataset page (task selector), populated from model repos' own .eval_results files: all entries verified=false (self-reported by model publishers, open-weight models only, not run by GPQA authors). Values from https://huggingface.co/api/datasets/Idavidrein/gpqa/leaderboard?task_id=diamond. The GPQA authors publish no leaderboard; repo baseline_results/ only has 2023 paper runs. HF config: gpqa_diamond (gated). 129 entries. Paper Table 5 (2023): Few-Shot CoT GPT-4 38.8.
rows.difficulty_detail:
Fitted level L2 (Standard); bootstrap agreement: L3 60%, L2 39%.
Placed from 88 models' published scores; guessing floor 25% removed.
Best observed: GPT-6.2 Astra 97.0, GPT-6.2 Sol 96.0, GPT-6 Astra 96.0.
Official difficulty: Paper: experts 81.2% on Diamond (selection-skewed), non-experts 21.9%.

rows.name: GPQA (main set)
rows.focus: Recommended 448-question main set: removes questions where both experts were wrong and all non-experts right (>=1/2 experts agree, <=2/3 non-experts correct).
rows.metrics_detail:
Quality [paper]: Accuracy by subset (%) — Main column of Tables 5 and 6: accuracy % for Llama-2-70B-chat, GPT-3.5-turbo-16k, GPT-4 and expert/non-expert human validators · https://arxiv.org/html/2311.12022
Effort [paper]: Evaluation Method (Zero-Shot, Few-Shot, Zero-Shot CoT, Few-Shot CoT, GPT-4 with search) — separate rows per prompting method / with web search · https://arxiv.org/html/2311.12022
Other [paper]: Abstention rate (%) — Table 7 gives the Main abstention rate per model/method · http
rows.notes: Leaderboard is the Hugging Face 'Official Benchmark' leaderboard on the dataset page (task selector), populated from model repos' own .eval_results files: all entries verified=false (self-reported by model publishers, open-weight models only, not run by GPQA authors). Values from https://huggingface.co/api/datasets/Idavidrein/gpqa/leaderboard?task_id=main. The GPQA authors publish no leaderboard; repo baseline_results/ only has 2023 paper runs. Only 9 entries; 3rd place tied with JetBrains/Mellum2-12B-A2.5B-Base (35.04). HF config: gpqa_main. Paper Table 5 (2023): GPT-4 with search 41.0, Few-Shot CoT GPT-4 39.7.
rows.difficulty_detail:
Not placed (re-checked 2026-11-27 with the full official data now imported): only 3 distinct models, 2 of them with scores on at least 2 other benchmarks; the scale needs at least 6 such models to place a benchmark.
Not placed: too few of its models could be matched to models with other scores (needs at least 6).

rows.name: GPQA Extended
rows.focus: Full released set of 546 expert-written questions (564 collected minus an 18-question unreleased held-out set).

rows.notes: No leaderboard on the OpenAI page; scores from the results table in OpenAI's simple-evals README, which stopped updating in July 2025 (OpenAI models only, no tools). 2nd/3rd tied at 49.4; o3-high 48.6.
